summary:
"Vestige" is an interactive, web-based virtual museum showcasing historical space exploration equipment deployed on the Moon and Mars.

We developed an accessible 3D web application featuring optimized models of iconic spacecraft and rovers-including the Curiosity and MER rovers, Mars Odyssey, Viking Lander, InSight, and etc. allowing users to inspect these off-world artifacts directly in their browser.

To address the challenge of making distant space history tangible and accessible, our project eliminates the need for specialized hardware or heavy downloads by delivering high-detail, performance-optimized 3D assets (GLB format) inside a streamlined web interface.

This project is important because humanity's pioneering robotic explorers remain isolated on other worlds, out of reach for traditional museum preservation. By digitally archiving and exhibiting these machines, "Vestige" preserves their engineering legacy, sparks public interest in space exploration, and ensures the stories of these trailblazing missions are remembered and experienced by future generations.
